reason: A offers the more substantive and testable mechanism: a temperature-dependent screw-to-edge slip transition with super-jog formation, linked to a measurable strength plateau and direct dislocation characterization against a low-temperature baseline. Its proposed links to elastic isotropy and thermal expansion are insufficiently established, but B is less mechanistically sound because ordinary anharmonicity already explains modulus/expansion trends and its asserted role of short-range ordering is vague, unsupported, and not decisively isolated.
